description: Traits the player can adapt on the fermenter cell. Each trait is the expression target of one protein_pool of the assembled cell (kernel parameter m_target_mod_<pool>); the pool moves its expression to the target, pays to build and keep the copies, and scales the protein it belongs to (a transporter's density or capacity, or the glycolytic enzymes' V_gly). All of that is CellML (circulatory-autogen-modules cell/protein_pool, protein_expression adaptive). The game only sets targets, within controls.expression_min/max of content/parameters.json and the membrane room the pools leave (protein__A_protein_max). Sliders change every cell of the selected cell's group. Proteins are offered only once they exist (content/timeline.json). Leaks are membrane properties, not proteins, so they are not traits.

range.note: whole flagella; the cell starts with one (user decision 2026-10-09). Each costs ~3e8 ATP to build and ~1.2e5 H+/s while it runs

traits.label: NhaA Na+/H+ antiporter copies
traits.note: linear flux-force kinetics: no midpoint yet

traits.label: KefC K+/H+ exchanger copies
traits.note: linear flux-force kinetics: no midpoint yet

expression_time_constant_note: user decision 2026-10-08: changes show within seconds; building is limited by build_capacity and by ATP, so large increases take minutes
midpoints: Kinetic midpoints are fixed (user decision 2026-10-08): ±10% changed almost nothing.
membrane_share_note: placeholder: the adaptable transporters may take 8% of the cell surface (baseline 2.3%); footprints are placeholders (F1Fo ~100 nm², 12-TM transporters ~12-15 nm²). The ceiling scales with membrane area.
build_capacity_note: placeholder: at most 5x the resting ATP turnover goes into building new protein (growing cells build protein at many times their maintenance rate)
build_atp_floor_note: placeholder control rule (stringent response): building runs at full speed at the resting ATP and stops at 4 mM, so it never starves the cell
